changelog.summary: Adds exact-plan comparison to current vendor, budget, security and approval review without implicit purchase.

title: Vendor Evaluation to Purchase Decision
description: Compare exact SaaS vendor plans against requirements and cost, then prepare a current, owner-reviewed purchase decision.
setup_prompt: Use Vendor Evaluation to Purchase Decision as a chat-led proposal. Inspect existing Vendor Researcher and Spend & Payables Coordinator Crews, buyer requirements, exact plans/quotes, term, currency, budget, vendor and overlapping subscription/PO records, security/privacy gates and approval owner. Propose reuse or reviewed creation, blocking handoff validation, a manual case and owner decision. Selecting this Playbook does not contact vendors, share customer data, create a vendor or PO, sign terms, pay, or enable recurrence.

setup_inputs.label: Tenant, legal entity, request, decision owner and exact vendor set
Versioned must-have and weighted requirements, region and evidence policy
Seats, term, comparable quote basis, currency and budget
Current plan/quote, vendor, subscription/PO, budget and policy sources or exports
Security, privacy, procurement and approval gates
Manual-only or reviewed procurement request event

recommended_tools.name: Builder create_crew
recommended_tools.purpose: Create reviewed missing evaluation or payables capability

recommended_tools.name: Vendor site, quote or approved document export
recommended_tools.purpose: Read exact product, plan, dated quote, terms and criterion evidence

recommended_tools.name: Vendor register, subscriptions and purchase orders
recommended_tools.purpose: Re-read duplicate vendor and committed spend state

recommended_tools.name: Budget and approval policy source
recommended_tools.purpose: Verify current available budget and purchase authority

pulse_focus.label: Vendor purchase decisions
focus_areas: Requirement and quote evidence for the exact plan
Current duplicate, security, privacy, budget and owner review state
review_when: A quote expires, a vendor or requirement changes, a gate is unresolved, or approval is pending

outputs: Validated vendor-comparison/v1 with cost assumptions and criterion evidence
Validated vendor-purchase-review/v1 with current gates and owner state
Manual case, blockers and activation choice
